gates.requirement: Both flow input modes resolve to identical states for equivalent Qp/Qs and Qt/r.
Capacity=Hb×kappa in Hb mode; direct B has no hidden Hb conversion.
Factors of 100 are correct for mL blood/kg/min and content per dL. Include a hand-calculated non-unit-flow fixture.
Systemic oxygen balance, pulmonary oxygen balance, complete-mixing identity, and closed-form DO2 match independently.
For admissible positive-demand states, net lung uptake equals M, systemic extraction equals M, DO2=M+venous return, and OER×Omega=1.
Fick ratio reconstructed from model saturations equals prescribed r except degenerate zero-demand/zero-gap cases.
Hb 10→14 fixed-flow example matches every supplied content, saturation, flux, and extraction result.
Increasing Hb at fixed flows/M/Spv raises Sa, Ca, Sv, DO2; Ca and DO2 changes equal analytic derivatives; net lung uptake remains unchanged.
Varying Qs at fixed Qp/M/Spv/B preserves Sa but changes DO2 and Cv.
Varying r at fixed Qt increases Sa but produces the specified conditional DO2 maximum, with admissibility masking.
Increasing M at fixed flows decreases DO2 and raises net lung uptake until feasibility fails.
Scaling Qp, Qs, M together preserves contents/saturations/OER/Omega and scales fluxes.
M=0 yields equal contents/saturations, net uptake/use=0, OER=0 when DO2>0, and undefined Omega/Fick estimate.
M=0 and Spv=0 yield degenerate zero-oxygen state, not an OER or Omega of zero by arbitrary convention.
M=positive and Spv=0 is infeasible; invalid input numbers/domain combinations are rejected.
Cv<0, including a plausible-looking Sa with high r, is masked and never clipped into a feasible point.
M at the zero-venous limit yields a distinctly labeled boundary; values on either side classify correctly with stated tolerance.
A<4M has no admissible r; A=4M has the sole boundary r=1; A>4M yields the analytic reciprocal root interval.
Conditional optimum matches derivative/search; no formal interior optimum is promoted when no admissible state exists.
